scheme_name: Credit Based Schemes For SC - Term Loan (TL)
other_conditions: Beneficiaries must be members of the Scheduled Caste category
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh
Applicants must contribute their share of assistance and provide any required subsidy
Applicants must arrange financial resources from other sources as per scheme guidelines
benefits_summary: Term loan up to 95% of project cost with interest rates of 6‑9% and repayment period of up to 10 years.
